chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم pronounced seventy takbirs over Hamzah.

key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةً: a single utterance of takbir in the funeral prayer context
key_terms.حَمْزَةَ: Hamzah, over whom the funeral takbirs were pronounced
key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.كَبَّرَ: pronounced the takbir, saying Allahu Akbar

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم pronounce over Hamzah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم pronounced seventy takbirs over Hamzah. It indicates the special status of Hamzah and relates to the practice of the funeral prayer.
